name: mascot-refined-flat
prompt: Redraw the exact same robot character from the reference image as a clean flat vector sticker on a transparent background: the retro-television-shaped head, the big off-white screen face with two tall black oval eyes, the pink blush ovals, the small cat-like smile, the two antennae with rounded tips, and the round headphone-like ear on its right side. Keep its colours: a smooth gradient of indigo #5B4BD6 into violet #8B5CF6 into soft pink #F0A6C8 on the body, with a dark indigo outline of even thickness. The character floats alone, centered and large, facing slightly to the viewer's right. Crisp edges, consistent line weight, soft cel shading, polished sticker look, no text.
